## AdapterLike  (type-only)
interface AdapterLike {
    readonly info?: {
        readonly vendor?: string;
        readonly architecture?: string;
        readonly description?: string;
        readonly isFallbackAdapter?: boolean;
    };
    readonly limits: {
        readonly maxTextureDimension2D: number;
        readonly maxBufferSize: number;
    };
}

## DeviceInfo  (type-only)
interface DeviceInfo {
    readonly touch: boolean;
    readonly ipad: boolean;
    readonly phone: boolean;
    readonly webkit: boolean;
    readonly cores: number;
    readonly headset: boolean;
    readonly automated: boolean;
    readonly gpu: GpuInfo | null;
}

## DynamicResolutionKnobOptions  (type-only)
interface DynamicResolutionKnobOptions {
    apply?: (scale: number) => void;
    step?: number;
    name?: string;
    cost?: number;
}

## Governor  (type-only)
interface Governor {
    targetMs: number;
    enabled: boolean;
    register(knob: Knob): () => void;
    frame(now: number, intervalMs: number, cpuMs?: number, latencyMs?: number | null): GovernorChange | null;
    set(count: number, now?: number): void;
    readonly shed: number;
    readonly knobs: readonly Knob[];
    readonly stack: readonly Knob[];
    readonly changes: readonly GovernorChange[];
    readonly line: string;
}

## GovernorChange  (type-only)
interface GovernorChange {
    readonly at: number;
    readonly shed: number;
    readonly knob: string;
    readonly dir: 'down' | 'up';
}

## GovernorOptions  (type-only)
interface GovernorOptions {
    targetMs?: number;
    rungs?: readonly Knob[];
    windowMs?: number;
    downShare?: number;
    upAfterMs?: number;
    upShare?: number;
    minGapMs?: number;
    maxChanges?: number;
    rateWindowMs?: number;
    stickyFailures?: number;
    stickyWithinMs?: number;
    stickyForMs?: number;
}

## GpuInfo  (type-only)
interface GpuInfo {
    readonly description: string;
    readonly fallback: boolean;
    readonly maxTexture: number;
    readonly maxBuffer: number;
}

## Knob  (type-only)
interface Knob {
    readonly name: string;
    step(down: boolean): boolean;
    readonly cost?: number;
}

## QUALITY_TIERS
const QUALITY_TIERS: readonly QualityTier[];

## QualityTier  (type-only)
type QualityTier = 'low' | 'medium' | 'high';

## StepKnobOptions  (type-only)
interface StepKnobOptions {
    name: string;
    get(): number;
    set(value: number): void;
    min: number;
    max: number;
    step: number;
    cost?: number;
}

## TierChoice  (type-only)
interface TierChoice {
    readonly tier: QualityTier;
    readonly reason: string;
}

function createGovernor(options?: GovernorOptions): Governor;

## detectTier
function detectTier(device?: DeviceInfo): TierChoice;

## dynamicResolutionKnob
function dynamicResolutionKnob(dr: Pick<DynamicResolution, 'scale' | 'minScale' | 'maxScale' | 'reset'>, opts?: DynamicResolutionKnobOptions): Knob;

function gpuInfo(adapter: AdapterLike): GpuInfo;

## headsetBrowser

## readDevice
function readDevice(gpu?: GpuInfo | null): DeviceInfo;
